newsitem.title: DUBAI: Egypt's Mubarak in Saudi Arabia on Gulf tour.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak in Saudi Arabia on Gulf tour.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak arrived in Saudi Arabia on Saturday after a brief visit to Kuwait as part of a Gulf tour expected to focus largely on the stalled Middle East peace process.
He was received at Jeddah airport by King Fahd, Crown Prince Abdullah and other senior officials.
The official Kuwaiti News Agency earlier said Mubarak would discuss several issues, "mainly the setback in the Middle East peace process".
Israel's start last month on construction of a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem brought the peace process to a halt.
On Friday, Mubarak told Egyptian television that he opposed holding an Arab summit at present for fear it could further complicate the peace talks by taking collective measures against Israel.
But a mini-summit could be held "for the sake of peace and not to take decisions," he added.
In Cairo, an official said Mubarak would also visit the United Arab Emirates during his Gulf tour.
